steps.name: multi-wallet-domain-schema
steps.summary: Normalized database schema by adding auth_user_wallets table and removing redundant wallet_address columns from auth_sessions and order_customers. Updated User, Customer, and AuthSession domain models, repositories, and dependency injections to support canonical multi-wallet references. Resolved PostgreSQL keyword clash by quoting 'primary' as '"primary"'. All 812 unit/integration/smoke tests pass successfully.

steps.name: wallet-link-unlink-api
steps.summary: Added authenticated wallet link/list/primary/revoke API surface with SIWE WALLET_LINK challenge purpose, target-user validation, active (chain_id, wallet) uniqueness checks, chain-scoped primary selection, last verified wallet revoke protection, and WalletLinked/WalletPrimaryChanged/WalletRevoked audit events. Added UserWalletRepository port and PostgreSQL implementation, wired live runtime auth facade with PostgresUserWalletRepository, extended auth challenge persistence with purpose/target_user_id, and updated route manifest/docs/Postman fixtures to the 47-route public surface. AC plus related route/fixture contract tests pass.

steps.name: checkout-wallet-selection
steps.summary: Added checkout walletId selection and chain-scoped primary wallet fallback using the auth UserWalletRepository. Order/payment commands, outbox payloads, tracking DTOs, and payment authorization persistence now carry canonical payer_wallet_id while deriving wallet addresses from verified active wallet snapshots instead of request-provided raw addresses. Foreign, revoked, and chain-mismatched wallets are rejected.

steps.name: multi-wallet-public-verification
steps.summary: Updated public API docs, Postman examples, expected response fixtures, and seed plan coverage to distinguish login wallet, linked wallet, payer wallet, and store settlement wallet. Documented that wallet revocation does not recover assets and kept DID/email recovery/ERC-6492 outside current scope.

steps.name: payment-asset-chain-registry-domain
steps.summary: Added PaymentChain, PaymentAsset, PaymentAssetType, and PaymentAssetRegistry domain values with asset-decimal minor unit validation. Added chains/payment_assets schema support, removed chain_name from payment/payment_authorization write SQL, added runtime asset registry loading from deployed_contracts.json or configured local token address, and added Ganache startup deployment of precompiled local USDC/USDT test contracts.

steps.name: wallet-asset-aware-pricing-checkout
steps.summary: Extended product/order checkout pricing to select explicit paymentAssetId prices, preserve assetId and amountMinorUnits in checkout outbox and tracking payloads, reject unsupported/disabled assets, and enforce selected payer wallet chain compatibility with the selected asset chain.

steps.name: erc20-payment-authorization-receipts
steps.summary: Added ERC-20 payment authorization terms with payer_wallet_id, payment_asset_id, token contract, amount minor units, and chain id. Added ERC-20 transfer calldata/request helpers, Transfer log receipt verification for wrong token/payer/recipient/amount/reverted receipts, and local JSON-RPC refund transaction submission gated by ADAPTER_BLOCKCHAIN_REFUND_PRIVATE_KEY.

steps.name: stablecoin-api-store-catalog-contracts
steps.summary: Added StorePaymentSettings.supported_payment_asset_ids, registry-backed public payment capability DTOs with supportedChains and acceptedAssets, store catalog persistence for supported payment assets, and docs/Postman examples for paymentAssetId and walletId without exposing internal gas/RPC config names.

steps.name: multi-wallet-stablecoin-public-verification
steps.summary: Locked public docs and smoke/seed fixture contracts around multi-wallet plus registry-driven native/USDC/USDT stablecoin checkout. Documented chain_id as canonical, separated expected authorization terms from observed payment receipt results, and left search/DID/email recovery/permit/gas sponsorship/swap as future scope.
